source: manuscript/results/dashboard_squad_sweep/game_day_mip_{sites,plans,schedule}_perP.csv, solved by scripts/60_game_day_mip.py (--squads all --max-squad 8 --min-moves-per-officer 1 --max-segments 150); geometry from data/osm_roads_suncorp.geojson
note: One solved maximal-covering roster per squad size and fixture. Each officer holds one post, relocates once (the sweep forces one relocation per officer), and is in transit for the bins between; transit earns no coverage. A bin is 15 minutes and bin 12 is kick-off.
coverage_metric: share of predicted speeding on the 150-segment candidate shortlist reached by the plan; coverage_network is the share of the whole network
